# Northstar Consumer data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `northstar data-dictionary`; edit src/northstar/schema.py instead. -->

Northstar Consumer is a fictional omnichannel retailer (web, app and physical stores) with a paid membership program, Northstar Plus. All records are synthetic: identifiers are sequential codes and no names, emails, addresses or other personal data exist.

## Time conventions

- History covers `2024-01-01` to `2026-01-01` (end exclusive), 24 months.
- Timestamps are timezone-naive, in the business's reporting timezone, at one-second resolution.
- The default modelling cutoff is `2025-07-01`. Features use rows with `time < cutoff`; outcome labels use `cutoff <= time < cutoff + horizon`.
- `northstar.timeline.snapshot(tables, cutoff)` returns the point-in-time view of every table (including masking support resolutions not yet known at the cutoff).
- Prospects created close to the end of the data are right-censored: they have had less time to convert. Conversion analyses must use a fixed outcome window.

## Entity relationships

```text
campaigns ─┬─< prospects ──1:0..1── customers ─┬─< orders ──< order_lines >── products
           │        │                          ├─< subscription_events
           │        ├─< sessions ──< funnel_events
           │        ├─< marketing_touches      └─< support_contacts
           │        └─< experiment_assignments >── experiments
           └─< marketing_touches / sessions / orders (campaign_id)
```

`prospect_id` is the person key used across the whole lifecycle. `customer_id` is set on sessions and touches only once the person has converted, so filtering by time never reveals a future conversion.

## `products`

Static product catalog.

- Grain: one row per product (SKU)
- Primary key: `product_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | string | no | Product identifier (`SKU####`). |
| `product_name` | string | no | Synthetic product label. |
| `category` | string | no | Merchandise category. Values: `apparel`, `footwear`, `home`, `beauty`, `outdoor`, `accessories`. |
| `list_price` | float | no | Regular unit price (USD). |
| `unit_cost` | float | no | Landed unit cost (USD); margin = price - cost. |

## `campaigns`

Marketing programs: quarterly paid acquisition, always-on lifecycle email programs and dated promotions.

- Grain: one row per campaign
- Primary key: `campaign_id`
- Time column: `start_date`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `campaign_id` | string | no | Campaign identifier (`CMP###`). |
| `campaign_name` | string | no | Human-readable campaign name. |
| `channel` | string | no | Delivery channel. Values: `paid_search`, `paid_social`, `display`, `affiliate`, `email`, `referral`, `organic_search`. |
| `objective` | string | no | Business objective. Values: `acquisition`, `nurture`, `retargeting`, `conversion`, `retention`, `winback`, `promotion`. |
| `start_date` | timestamp | no | First active day (midnight). |
| `end_date` | timestamp | no | Last active day, inclusive (midnight). |
| `discount_pct` | float | no | Discount offered by the campaign (0 if none). |

## `experiments`

Registry of randomized experiments embedded in the data.

- Grain: one row per experiment
- Primary key: `experiment_id`
- Time column: `start_date`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `experiment_id` | string | no | Experiment identifier. |
| `experiment_name` | string | no | Short name. |
| `hypothesis` | string | no | Pre-registered hypothesis. |
| `randomization_unit` | string | no | Unit of assignment. |
| `eligible_population` | string | no | Who can be assigned. |
| `start_date` | timestamp | no | First day of the experiment. |
| `end_date` | timestamp | no | Last day of the experiment, inclusive. |
| `treatment_share` | float | no | Target share of units assigned to treatment. |
| `primary_metric` | string | no | Pre-registered primary metric. |
| `guardrail_metrics` | string | no | Pre-registered guardrail metrics. |

## `prospects`

Every identified lead (sign-up, account creation or captured email). Contains only attributes known when the lead is created - no conversion outcome.

- Grain: one row per person, created at first identified visit
- Primary key: `prospect_id`
- Time column: `created_at`
- Foreign key: `campaign_id` -> `campaigns.campaign_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prospect_id` | string | no | Person identifier (`P######`); stable across the lifecycle. |
| `created_at` | timestamp | no | When the lead was created. |
| `acquisition_channel` | string | no | Channel that sourced the lead. Values: `paid_search`, `paid_social`, `display`, `affiliate`, `email`, `referral`, `organic_search`. |
| `campaign_id` | string | yes | Sourcing campaign (paid, email-list and referral leads). |
| `region` | string | no | Home region. Values: `northeast`, `southeast`, `midwest`, `southwest`, `west`. |
| `age_band` | string | no | Self-reported age band. Values: `18-24`, `25-34`, `35-44`, `45-54`, `55-64`, `65+`. |
| `income_band` | string | no | Modelled household income band. Values: `low`, `middle`, `high`. |
| `device_type` | string | no | Device used at lead creation. Values: `mobile`, `desktop`, `tablet`. |
| `email_opt_in` | bool | no | Consented to marketing email at creation. |

## `customers`

Prospects who placed a first order. Attributes are copied from the prospect record; no post-conversion aggregates (lifetime value, churn status) are stored.

- Grain: one row per customer
- Primary key: `customer_id`
- Time column: `customer_since`
- Foreign key: `prospect_id` -> `prospects.prospect_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | string | no | Customer identifier (`C######`), issued in order of conversion. |
| `prospect_id` | string | no | Originating prospect. |
| `customer_since` | timestamp | no | Timestamp of the first order. |
| `acquisition_channel` | string | no | Channel that sourced the lead. Values: `paid_search`, `paid_social`, `display`, `affiliate`, `email`, `referral`, `organic_search`. |
| `region` | string | no | Home region. Values: `northeast`, `southeast`, `midwest`, `southwest`, `west`. |
| `age_band` | string | no | Age band. Values: `18-24`, `25-34`, `35-44`, `45-54`, `55-64`, `65+`. |
| `income_band` | string | no | Income band. Values: `low`, `middle`, `high`. |
| `device_type` | string | no | Device used at lead creation. Values: `mobile`, `desktop`, `tablet`. |
| `email_opt_in` | bool | no | Marketing email consent at lead creation. |

## `marketing_touches`

Outbound and paid marketing interactions: sourcing ad clicks, nurture/retargeting, newsletters, promotions and win-back emails.

- Grain: one row per touch delivered to a person
- Primary key: `touch_id`
- Time column: `touch_at`
- Foreign key: `prospect_id` -> `prospects.prospect_id`
- Foreign key: `customer_id` -> `customers.customer_id`
- Foreign key: `campaign_id` -> `campaigns.campaign_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `touch_id` | string | no | Touch identifier. |
| `prospect_id` | string | no | Person touched. |
| `customer_id` | string | yes | Set only when the person was already a customer at touch time. |
| `campaign_id` | string | no | Campaign that generated the touch. |
| `channel` | string | no | Delivery channel. Values: `paid_search`, `paid_social`, `display`, `affiliate`, `email`, `referral`, `organic_search`. |
| `touch_type` | string | no | Kind of interaction. Values: `ad_click`, `email`, `referral_credit`. |
| `touch_at` | timestamp | no | Delivery (email) or click (ads) time. |
| `opened` | bool | no | Email opened (always true for ad clicks). |
| `clicked` | bool | no | Clicked through to the site/app. |
| `cost` | float | no | Variable media/delivery cost (USD). |

## `sessions`

Web and app visits by identified people (anonymous traffic is out of scope).

- Grain: one row per session
- Primary key: `session_id`
- Time column: `session_start`
- Foreign key: `prospect_id` -> `prospects.prospect_id`
- Foreign key: `customer_id` -> `customers.customer_id`
- Foreign key: `campaign_id` -> `campaigns.campaign_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | string | no | Session identifier. |
| `prospect_id` | string | no | Visitor. |
| `customer_id` | string | yes | Set only when the session started after the first order. |
| `session_start` | timestamp | no | Session start. |
| `platform` | string | no | Digital property. Values: `web`, `app`. |
| `device_type` | string | no | Device. Values: `mobile`, `desktop`, `tablet`. |
| `traffic_source` | string | no | Attributed traffic source. Values: `paid_search`, `paid_social`, `display`, `affiliate`, `email`, `referral`, `organic_search`, `direct`. |
| `campaign_id` | string | yes | Campaign that drove the visit, if any. |
| `pages_viewed` | int | no | Page/screen views in the session. |

## `funnel_events`

Ordered funnel milestones within sessions. A session reaching stage k has exactly one event for each stage 1..k.

- Grain: one row per session x stage reached
- Primary key: `event_id`
- Time column: `event_ts`
- Foreign key: `session_id` -> `sessions.session_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_id` | string | no | Event identifier. |
| `session_id` | string | no | Session. |
| `event_ts` | timestamp | no | Event time (non-decreasing along the funnel). |
| `event_type` | string | no | Funnel stage. Values: `session_start`, `product_view`, `add_to_cart`, `checkout_start`, `purchase`. |
| `stage_number` | int | no | 1 = session_start ... 5 = purchase. |

## `orders`

Completed orders across web, app and store.

- Grain: one row per order
- Primary key: `order_id`
- Time column: `order_ts`
- Foreign key: `customer_id` -> `customers.customer_id`
- Foreign key: `session_id` -> `sessions.session_id`
- Foreign key: `campaign_id` -> `campaigns.campaign_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | string | no | Order identifier. |
| `customer_id` | string | no | Purchasing customer. |
| `order_ts` | timestamp | no | Order time (equals the purchase event time). |
| `order_channel` | string | no | Sales channel. Values: `web`, `app`, `store`. |
| `session_id` | string | yes | Purchase session for web/app orders; null for store orders. |
| `campaign_id` | string | yes | Discount campaign applied, if any. |
| `item_count` | int | no | Total units. |
| `gross_amount` | float | no | Sum of line list value (USD). |
| `discount_amount` | float | no | Total discount (USD). |
| `net_amount` | float | no | gross_amount - discount_amount (USD). |

## `order_lines`

Products within orders.

- Grain: one row per order x product
- Primary key: `order_line_id`
- Time column: inherited from `orders.order_ts`
- Foreign key: `order_id` -> `orders.order_id`
- Foreign key: `product_id` -> `products.product_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_line_id` | string | no | Order line identifier. |
| `order_id` | string | no | Order. |
| `product_id` | string | no | Product. |
| `quantity` | int | no | Units. |
| `unit_price` | float | no | Unit list price at time of order (USD). |
| `discount_amount` | float | no | Line discount (USD). |
| `net_amount` | float | no | quantity * unit_price - discount_amount (USD). |

## `subscription_events`

Northstar Plus membership lifecycle (monthly $9.99 or annual $89 plans).

- Grain: one row per membership event
- Primary key: `subscription_event_id`
- Time column: `event_ts`
- Foreign key: `customer_id` -> `customers.customer_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription_event_id` | string | no | Event identifier. |
| `customer_id` | string | no | Member. |
| `event_ts` | timestamp | no | Event time. |
| `event_type` | string | no | subscribe / renew / cancel (cancel takes effect at the end of the paid period). Values: `subscribe`, `renew`, `cancel`. |
| `plan` | string | no | Membership plan. Values: `monthly`, `annual`. |
| `amount` | float | no | Fee charged (0 for cancellations). |

## `support_contacts`

Customer service contacts. Resolution time and CSAT become known only at `resolved_at`; `timeline.snapshot` masks them for contacts unresolved at the cutoff.

- Grain: one row per contact
- Primary key: `contact_id`
- Time column: `contact_ts`
- Foreign key: `customer_id` -> `customers.customer_id`
- Foreign key: `order_id` -> `orders.order_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contact_id` | string | no | Contact identifier. |
| `customer_id` | string | no | Customer. |
| `order_id` | string | yes | Related order, if any. |
| `contact_ts` | timestamp | no | Contact opened. |
| `contact_channel` | string | no | Contact channel. Values: `chat`, `email`, `phone`. |
| `reason` | string | no | Contact reason. Values: `delivery_delay`, `return_request`, `product_quality`, `billing`, `account_access`. |
| `resolved_at` | timestamp | yes | Resolution time; null if never resolved. |
| `csat_score` | int | yes | Post-resolution satisfaction 1-5; null when the survey was not answered. |

## `experiment_assignments`

Randomized assignment of prospects to experiment arms (deterministic hash of experiment_id and prospect_id), logged at first eligible exposure.

- Grain: one row per experiment x prospect
- Primary key: `experiment_id, prospect_id`
- Time column: `assigned_at`
- Foreign key: `experiment_id` -> `experiments.experiment_id`
- Foreign key: `prospect_id` -> `prospects.prospect_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `experiment_id` | string | no | Experiment. |
| `prospect_id` | string | no | Assigned prospect. |
| `variant` | string | no | Arm. Values: `control`, `treatment`. |
| `assigned_at` | timestamp | no | First eligible session start in the window. |
